t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Try each of the gnomes to see which one gives the most mushrooms, stay with the gnome that gives more until it stops giving you a lot of mushrooms, then switch to the other gnome.

vb_textbox.text: Pick a gnome and stick with it until it gives out 2 or less mushrooms then switch to the other gnome. Keep doing this for the entire game.
